description: Revert to the stable Depth=8 configuration with the high Matrix LR (0.08) that achieved the best result (0.9878), but increase the Embedding LR from 0.6 back to 0.8 to maximize the learning speed of the input/output projections, as previous experiments showed that higher embedding LRs combined with the stable 0.08 matrix LR yielded the lowest val_bpb.
